|game_text=Once per game may ▼ a device on Aurra. While armed with a [Reflections III] rifle: it may not be retargeted or stolen, her total weapon destiny is +1, and characters she hits may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 4 while armed with a rifle).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin]] (original, release sheet of 11 May 2012); [[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Players Committee card image, uploaded 7 May 2013, the same words as the original, the current text). The Master List of 27 April 2013 ([[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin (Errata 2)]]) has the same words; the card image is current only because it was uploaded later, on its server's bulk upload date, which is the only date known for it.
* '''Original''' ([[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of May 11, 2012"; this copy was re-made on 18 July 2012), page 2, slip 1 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Once per game may ▼ a device on Aurra. While armed with a [Reflections III] rifle: it may not be retargeted or stolen, her total weapon destiny is +1, and characters she hits may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 4 while armed with a rifle).” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-01-Aurra_Sing_Deadly_Assassin.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-aurrasingdeadlyassassin-pre.gif]]) print it. The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=4, page 4. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E2 ([[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin (Errata 2)]]); the current text is the PC card image uploaded on 7 May 2013 ([[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin (Errata 3)]], the same words). The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) has “Once per game, ▼” (written out “deploy a device on Aurra from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”) instead of “Once per game may ▼”, “rifle, it” instead of “rifle: it” and “(or < 4 if armed with a rifle)” instead of “(< 4 while armed with a rifle)”<ref name="cl-1281_1-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]</ref>: “Once per game, ▼ a device on Aurra. While armed with a [Reflections III] rifle, it may not be retargeted or stolen, her total weapon destiny is +1, and characters she hits may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 3 (or < 4 if armed with a rifle).” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-01-Aurra_Sing_Deadly_Assassin-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 4)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin]]) again, word for word: “Once per game may ▼ a device on Aurra. While armed with a [Reflections III] rifle: it may not be retargeted or stolen, her total weapon destiny is +1, and characters she hits may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 4 while armed with a rifle).” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text); the PC card image uploaded later (this page) is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-1-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-aurrasingdeadlyassassin-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Aurra Sing, Deadly Assassin]]) again, word for word: “Once per game may ▼ a device on Aurra. While armed with a [Reflections III] rifle: it may not be retargeted or stolen, her total weapon destiny is +1, and characters she hits may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 4 while armed with a rifle).” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual8-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 7 May 2013, 13:52<ref name="pcdir-Virtual8-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034744/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). Uploaded after the Master List, it is the latest version and so the current text. The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
